subject: DPIA evidence + data-flow verification request — Helios pilot
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliosfinance.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliosfinance.com
Date: 2027-11-10T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request for DPIA evidence and data-flow verification for Helios pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the Helios product team is excited to proceed with a small pilot. As part of our compliance intake we need a short evidence pack to complete our DPIA and internal approvals. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2027-11-12)?

- Current list of Redwood subprocessors involved in the Helios pilot (processing vendors, cloud infra, monitoring). A CSV export would be ideal.
- Data flow diagram showing where Helios production and staging data would flow (ingress, processing, backups, monitoring telemetry). PDF or Visio OK.
- Excerpt of your Article 30 processing register showing Helios-relevant processing activities (purpose, categories, retention).
- Confirmation of transfer mechanisms: SCCs, UK Addendum, or other legal basis for cross-border transfers.
- Point of contact for any follow-up technical questions and an expected turnaround for deeper evidence requests (logs, sampling).

We may need to schedule a short DPIA walkthrough if anything is missing. Procurement copied for timing/contract sequencing.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement.

Best,
Elena Soto
Privacy & Risk
Helios Financial

--
Attachment: helm-pilot-intake.pdf (application intake form, 82KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: 2027-11-10T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request for DPIA evidence and data-flow verification for Helios pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Acknowledged and we can deliver an initial evidence bundle by COB Friday.

Quick notes / plan:
- Marcus will pull the current subprocessor export and a brief summary of the roles (storage, monitoring, KMS).
- Neha will prepare a Helios-scoped dataflow diagram (PDF) and an excerpt of the Article 30 register showing categories + retention.
- I will confirm transfer mechanisms and provide the SCC/transfer references and our standard UK Addendum text where applicable.

If you expect log-level exports or SOC-2 artifacts during the first pass, flag that now so we can prioritize.

I'll upload the bundle to a shared Drive folder and send a link when ready.

Regards,
Kimberly Park

Kim / Neha — starting to compile items. Early status:

- Subprocessor list: CSV export attached (redwood_subprocessor_list.csv). Includes role, country, and minimal contact. I flagged one new monitoring vendor (Observly) that is EU-hosted; noting reason for use.
- Article 30 excerpt: I pulled Helios-relevant rows (article30_register_excerpt.csv). It includes processing categories and retention baselines.
- Transfer mechanisms: Redwood primarily relies on SCCs plus UK Addendum for EU/UK transfers; will confirm the latest signed versions and provide links.

Action items for Neha: can you include a short callout in the dataflow PDF about telemetry retention (30 days default) and backup retention (90 days), and mark which connections transit outside the EU? Helios asked specifically about staging vs production separation.

I'll attach the CSVs to the Drive folder and mark proprietary fields with a note.

Marcus

Thanks Marcus and Kimberly — that looks good. A couple of clarifications from the DPIA team:

1) For the subprocessor CSV: please include the country of the data centre where Helios data would be stored (if different than corporate HQ of the vendor).
2) For the dataflow diagram: can you clearly label which components sit in our VPC in the Helios pilot vs Redwood-managed shared services? We need to demonstrate separation in the DPIA.

If you can add those two items to the bundle we can likely avoid the additional walkthrough. Otherwise we'll request a 30-minute call on Monday.

Procurement: FYI on timing — if evidence arrives Friday we can keep the contract milestone for early December.

Elena
